user.title: Octopus Agile tariff
user.description: Pick the electricity region for your meter. Prices are half-hourly and are published for the next day at around 16:00 UK time.

data_description.region: The GSP region letter from your electricity bill (the tariff is built as E-1R-<product>-<letter>).
data_description.product_code: Defaults to the current Agile product. Only change this if Octopus releases a new version.
data_description.price_cap: Leave empty to use the automatic Ofgem price cap. Enter your regional cap rate for a more accurate comparison line.

error.no_rates: No Agile rates found for this region and product code. Check them and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the Octopus Energy API. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

init.title: Octopus Agile options
init.description: Adjust the product code or the price cap used for the comparison line. Clear the cap to fall back to the automatic Ofgem value.

data_description.price_cap: Enter your regional Ofgem cap unit rate for a more accurate line, or clear it to use the built-in national average.

error.no_rates: No Agile rates found for this region and product code.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the Octopus Energy API.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.
